g.title: Raw authentication event. Schema lives entirely in the domain.
Sliding-window behavioural features (velocity, novelty, geo, device consistency).
XGBoost risk_score + top SHAP signals + GateRoute decision.
The only function crossing the domain → framework boundary. Translates the three domain artifacts into the framework Observation contract.
Domain-agnostic ML evidence: reasoner_id, model_version, inference_latency_ms, label_type/name/value, full feature_set (replay-self-contained), attribution.
Gate dispatch envelope: gate_id, prompt_template_id, template_vars, jurisdictions, risk_tier. Required on EVERY observation, including fast-path (enables shadow evaluation).
Required iff route is FAST_PATH_ALLOW or FAST_PATH_BLOCK. Human-readable string explaining the confidence-band rule that fired (e.g., 'risk_score=0.93 > 0.85 → FAST_PATH_BLOCK').
FAST_PATH_ALLOW | FAST_PATH_BLOCK | ROUTE_TO_GATE. Determines the framework-side path.
Framework intake gate. Enforces: reasoner_context populated; fast_path_rationale populated iff route is fast-path. Raises ObservationContractError naming the responsible reasoner.
ROUTE_TO_GATE → retrieval + gate. FAST_PATH_* → fast_path.
Hybrid retrieval (pgvector + ES + rerank) → LLM policy gate (rendered template + structured-output JSON verdict).
Skip retrieval and live gate. Enforce ALLOW or BLOCK directly. GateContext is preserved on the bundle so the gate can be replayed offline (shadow evaluation).
Pure deterministic resolver — re-runnable byte-identically against the cached gate verdict. The replay guarantee.
Append-only audit record: raw_event (Observation), retrieval results, gate_input/gate_output, enforcement decision, latency breakdown.
